notes: ⚠️ A SWITCH YOU CLICKED TURNED ON AND CHANGED NOTHING. A switch that lives inside its own label is activated TWICE when the click lands on the switch itself — once by the control, once by the label handing it back — so it flipped on screen…

THE DIVIDER RUNS THE FULL HEIGHT OF EVERY SCREEN. It is the left column's own border, so it was only ever as long as that column was tall — and a column that sizes to its content stops short of one that does not, which is the gap you saw.

NO MORE SCROLLBAR ON CONTENT THAT FITS. The view asked for a minimum of the full container height and then added its own border to that, making itself one pixel taller than the space it was measuring against.
RESCAN DISPLAYS MOVED INTO THE SCREEN, under the line that says what the map is. It was in the header, where the approved design puts a view's action.
